main.description: Generate a 20-page manga episode for a given character. Kicks the BPMN process com.etzhayyim.apps.bpmn.generateEpisode which orchestrates: LLM script (20 pages × 3-5 panels with dialogue) → ComfyUI panel render (~76 panels) → Pillow speech-balloon overlay → page composition (3-7 panel grids) → multi-record write (1 work + 20 pages) → social post (recordWithMedia + facets) → OCEL audit emit at each phase. Returns the new episode (work) AT URI plus the BPMN process instance key for status tracking.

charSlug.description: Character slug (kebab-case, e.g. rei-ayanami-evangelion). Maps to did:web:sh1n5h1x.etzhayyim.com:{slug} as protagonist DID.

charName.description: Display name shown in the post (e.g. Rei).

appearance.description: Visual descriptor tags fed to SDXL prompt (e.g. 'blue hair red eyes pale skin school uniform').

genre.description: Manga genre — controls art-style tags + dialogue register.

setting.description: Optional scene setting (e.g. 'rainy alley at night'). If omitted, randomly picked from a curated set.

checkpoint.description: ComfyUI checkpoint name (must be in pod allowlist).

episodeUri.description: AT URI of the created com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.work record.

processInstanceKey.description: Zeebe process instance key — use com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.getProcessTrace to inspect.

postUri.description: AT URI of the published app.bsky.feed.post.
